description: This Java source file defines an immutable event class 'SubscriptionHasNextPage' used in a reactive streams context to represent the availability of the next page of search results in a subscription-based system. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, retrieving the JSON array of items, and serialization logic.

classes.name: SubscriptionHasNextPage
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a 'next page' notification for a subscription search, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new SubscriptionHasNextPage instance with specified subscription ID, items, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionHasNextPage instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the JSON array of items in the next page.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Creates a copy of this event with a new JSON array of items.
